knowledge:
- key_parameters: counts=A data frame, matrix, or SummarizedExperiment object containing RNA-seq count data ;; group=A vector specifying the group of each sample ;; groupCol=The column name in colData of SummarizedExperiment that contains sample group information ;; filte=Logical value indicating whether to filter low-expression genes in differential_RNA ;; method=Statistical method for differential RNA analysis (e.g., "Wilcoxon") ;; normMethod=Normalization method for methylation data in differential_methy (can be NULL) ;; cpg2gene=A data frame mapping CpG sites to gene symbols ;; keyType=The type of gene identifier (e.g., "SYMBOL") used in countToFpkm and countToTpm ;; gene_cov=Gene coverage data frame used for FPKM/TPM normalization
- alternatives: TCGAbiolinks or GDCRNATools for downloading and analyzing TCGA gene expression data ;; edgeR, limma, or DESeq2 for identifying differentially expressed genes ;; CQN for correcting systematic gene length and GC-content biases ;; GOseq for correcting gene length bias in enrichment analysis ;; ChAMP for DNA methylation analysis (which differential_methy depends on) ;; clusterProfiler::bitr for gene ID conversion (planned for future versions of GeoTcgaData)
- when_to_use: Use when performing differential analysis on RNA-seq, DNA methylation, CNV, or SNP data from TCGA or GEO, or when preprocessing GEO microarray data (averaging duplicate gene symbols, resolving multi-mapped probe IDs) and converting TCGA raw counts to FPKM/TPM.
- pitfalls: Technical replicate RNA-seq data with small gene dispersions can show a strong read count bias where longer transcripts or higher read counts are more likely to be identified as differentially expressed ;; GOseq may overcorrect data that has no gene length bias but only expression bias, leading to reverse bias ;; For DNA methylation, using model = "cpg" (calculating difference CpGs first, then genes) can introduce CpG number bias, whereas model = "gene" (calculating gene methylation levels first, then differences) avoids this bias ;; ChAMP has a large number of dependent packages; if installation fails, they must be downloaded and installed locally.

workflows.name: rna_seq_differential_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform differential expression analysis on RNA-seq count data using a Wilcoxon test or other methods.
input: df (matrix or data frame of raw RNA-seq counts)
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare the count matrix and group vector (or construct a SummarizedExperiment object) ;; 2. Run differential_RNA to identify differentially expressed genes.
workflows.code:
df <- matrix ( rnbinom ( 400 , mu = 4 , size = 10 ), 25 , 16 )
df <- as.data.frame (df)
rownames (df) <- paste0 ( "gene" , 1 : 25 )
colnames (df) <- paste0 ( "sample" , 1 : 16 )
group <- sample ( c ( "group1" , "group2" ), 16 , replace = TRUE )
result <- differential_RNA ( counts = df, group = group, filte = FALSE , method = "Wilcoxon" )

df <- matrix ( rnbinom ( 400 , mu = 4 , size = 10 ), 25 , 16 )
rownames (df) <- paste0 ( "gene" , 1 : 25 )
colnames (df) <- paste0 ( "sample" , 1 : 16 )
group <- sample ( c ( "group1" , "group2" ), 16 , replace = TRUE )
nrows <- 200 ; ncols <- 20
counts <- matrix ( runif (nrows * ncols, 1 , 1e4 ), nrows, dimnames = list ( paste0 ( "cg" , 1 : 200 ), paste0 ( "S" , 1 : 20 )) )
colData <- S4Vectors :: DataFrame ( row.names = paste0 ( "sample" , 1 : 16 ), group = group )
data <- SummarizedExperiment :: SummarizedExperiment ( assays= S4Vectors :: SimpleList ( counts= df), colData = colData)
result <- differential_RNA ( counts = data, groupCol = "group" , filte = FALSE , method = "Wilcoxon" )

workflows.name: dna_methylation_differential_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify differentially methylated genes from CpG methylation data.
input: cpgData (matrix or SummarizedExperiment of CpG methylation levels)
cpg2gene (data frame mapping CpG probe IDs to gene symbols)
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare CpG methylation matrix, sample groups, and CpG-to-gene mapping ;; 2. Run differential_methy to identify differentially methylated genes.
workflows.code:
library(ChAMP)
cpgData <- matrix(runif(2000), nrow = 200, ncol = 10)
rownames(cpgData) <- paste0("cpg", seq_len(200))
colnames(cpgData) <- paste0("sample", seq_len(10))
sampleGroup <- c(rep("group1", 5), rep("group2", 5))
names(sampleGroup) <- colnames(cpgData)
cpg2gene <- data.frame(cpg = rownames(cpgData), 
    gene = rep(paste0("gene", seq_len(20)), 10))
result <- differential_methy(cpgData, sampleGroup, 
    cpg2gene = cpg2gene, normMethod = NULL)

library(ChAMP)
cpgData <- matrix(runif(2000), nrow = 200, ncol = 10)
rownames(cpgData) <- paste0("cpg", seq_len(200))
colnames(cpgData) <- paste0("sample", seq_len(10))
sampleGroup <- c(rep("group1", 5), rep("group2", 5))
names(sampleGroup) <- colnames(cpgData)
cpg2gene <- data.frame(cpg = rownames(cpgData), 
    gene = rep(paste0("gene", seq_len(20)), 10))
colData <- S4Vectors::DataFrame(
    row.names = colnames(cpgData),
    group = sampleGroup
)
data <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(
         assays=S4Vectors::SimpleList(counts=cpgData),
         colData = colData)
result <- differential_methy(cpgData = data, 
    groupCol = "group", normMethod = NULL, 
    cpg2gene = cpg2gene)

workflows.name: cnv_differential_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify genes with differential copy number variations between groups.
input: aa (matrix of gene-level copy number scores)
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare the copy number score matrix and sample groups ;; 2. Run differential_CNV to extract differential CNV genes.
workflows.code:
aa <- matrix(sample(c(0, 1, -1), 200, replace = TRUE), 25, 8)
rownames(aa) <- paste0("gene", 1:25)
colnames(aa) <- paste0("sample", 1:8)
sampleGroup <- sample(c("A", "B"), ncol(aa), replace = TRUE)
diffCnv <- differential_CNV(aa, sampleGroup)

workflows.name: snp_qc_and_differential_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform quality control and differential analysis on single nucleotide variation (SNP) data.
input: snpDf (data frame of SNP mutation data)
workflows.stages: 1. Run SNP_QC to perform quality control on the SNP data frame ;; 2. Run differential_SNP to identify differentially mutated SNPs.
workflows.code:
snpDf <- matrix(sample(c("AA", "Aa", "aa"), 100, replace = TRUE), 10, 10)
snpDf <- as.data.frame(snpDf)
sampleGroup <- sample(c("A", "B"), 10, replace = TRUE)
result <- SNP_QC(snpDf)

snpDf <- matrix(sample(c("mutation", NA), 100, replace = TRUE), 10, 10)
snpDf <- as.data.frame(snpDf)
sampleGroup <- sample(c("A", "B"), 10, replace = TRUE)
result <- differential_SNP(snpDf, sampleGroup)

workflows.name: geo_chip_data_preprocessing
workflows.intent: Preprocess GEO microarray data by averaging duplicate gene symbols and resolving multi-mapped probe IDs.
input: file_gene_ave (data frame of gene expression with duplicate gene symbols)
input_file (data frame of expression data with multi-mapped probe IDs)
workflows.stages: 1. Average expression values of different IDs for the same gene using gene_ave ;; 2. Resolve multi-mapped probe IDs by either assigning the expression to each gene using repAssign or deleting them using repRemove.

workflows.name: tcga_id_conversion_and_normalization
workflows.intent: Convert TCGA ENSEMBL gene IDs to gene symbols and normalize raw counts to FPKM or TPM.
input: profile (matrix or data frame of TCGA gene expression data with ENSEMBL IDs)
workflows.stages: 1. Convert ENSEMBL gene IDs to gene symbols using id_conversion_TCGA ;; 2. Convert raw counts to FPKM using countToFpkm ;; 3. Convert raw counts to TPM using countToTpm.
workflows.code:
data(profile)
result <- id_conversion_TCGA(profile)

data(gene_cov)
lung_squ_count2 <- matrix(c(1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9),ncol=3)
rownames(lung_squ_count2) <- c("DISC1","TCOF1","SPPL3")
colnames(lung_squ_count2) <- c("sample1","sample2","sample3")
result <- countToFpkm(lung_squ_count2, keyType = "SYMBOL", 
    gene_cov = gene_cov)

data(gene_cov)
lung_squ_count2 <- matrix(c(0.11,0.22,0.43,0.14,0.875,
    0.66,0.77,0.18,0.29),ncol=3)
rownames(lung_squ_count2) <- c("DISC1","TCOF1","SPPL3")
colnames(lung_squ_count2) <- c("sample1","sample2","sample3")
result <- countToTpm(lung_squ_count2, keyType = "SYMBOL", 
    gene_cov = gene_cov)
